text:
maria.g: Following the postmortem, we need explicit owners + short timelines for the streaming/chat reliability items: timeout tuning, partial-response detection, reconnect/backoff behavior. Noting a recurring pattern: long-lived streams (~>45s) have a ~2% partial-response rate. Can folks ack ownership and give a quick plan?

jon.p: I can take the reconnect/backoff work. Goal: make client reconnects less aggressive and add server-side session hints so clients can choose backoff early. Will open RFC PR today, code PR by Thu.

anya: I'll own partial-response detection and alerting. Proposal: emit `stream.incomplete` with labels (model, route, duration) and add SLI for end-to-end completeness. ETA: wire metrics + PagerDuty rule by Wednesday.

maria.g: good. Include expected rollouts (canary %, region) in your PR descriptions so ops can schedule.

derek: I'll handle timeouts and keepalive intervals. Plan: reduce idleTimeout to 20s for long-stream routes, add graceful EOF marker `__END__` for stable clients, and add an integration test that simulates token stalls. ETA: Friday EOD.

jon.p: reconnect config draft for clients:

```
reconnect: {
  initialDelayMs: 250,
  maxDelayMs: 8000,
  multiplier: 1.6,
  jitterFactor: 0.25,
  maxRetries: 10
}
```

anya: detection pseudocode I sketched: 

```
if (stream.closed && !stream.ended && duration > minDuration) {
  record('stream.incomplete', {model, route, duration});
  if (countInWindow(route, 1h) > 5) trigger_regression_alert();
}
```

derek: integration test will assert that when server emits heartbeat every 12s, client doesn't time out; and when heartbeat stops, stream marked partial.

sre-bot: incident-tracker: created task STREAM-487 for reconnect/backoff, STREAM-488 for partial-detection, STREAM-489 for timeout-tuning. Assigned to jon.p, anya, derek respectively.

maria.g: please add these action IDs to the postmortem doc (https://go/internal/pm-streaming) and migrate anything actionable to the sprint board. Also add a recurring weekly triage for streaming anomalies.

jon.p: will add canary plan: 5% traffic in us-west for 48h, auto-rollback on 1.0% increase in partials.

anya: I'll add dashboard panels: partial rate by route, median stream duration, and last-heartbeat latency.

maria.g: thanks all. Let's sync briefly after canary starts. Re-check ownership next Friday if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
